$comment: profiles/index.json -- the pack's own table of contents, and the ONE place the stack set and the verb set are written down. Both lists are DATA on purpose: src/dev/matrix.ts renders the page without a single stack id or verb name as a literal, and src/profiles/pack.ts refuses a profile whose verb map is not exactly `verbs` -- no extra verb, no missing one. Adding a stack is a file plus a line here; adding a verb is a line here plus that verb in all seven profiles, which is the point.
$order: `profiles` is sorted; `verbs` is the family's own declared order (nen shu detect | build | test | ui-test | lint | archive | release | dev | run | deploy | coverage | tools | warmup) and is NOT sorted -- it is the order the matrix's columns are read in.
